lessons.communicativeOutcome: Form concessive complex sentences: 'Гадаа хүйтэн байвч, гэрийн дотор маш дулаахан байна' (Although it is cold outside, inside the ger it is very warm), 'Ядарсан боловч ажлаа дуусгав' (Although tired, finished the work).
lessons.audioPurpose: Model phonological attachment of -вч across vowel and consonant stems.

grammarOverview.summary: Introduce indefinite pronouns combined with emphatic particle ч and negative predicates expressing absolute negative polarity: хэн ч биш / байхгүй (nobody), юу ч үгүй / хийхгүй (nothing), хаашаа ч үгүй (nowhere), хэзээ ч үгүй (never).
